task: Generate one photorealistic still frame from a casual vertical video someone recorded with an iPhone: a close-up of the same woman applying a drop of serum to her cheek with her fingertips, filmed with her phone propped against the bathroom mirror. It will be the first frame of a short B-roll clip, so it must feel candid and authentic, like a frame from an everyday phone video, not a stock photo or an ad. Attached image 1 is the exact product: replicate it identically (same bottle shape, size, materials, colors, label design and label text), as described in "product". Attached image 2 shows the same person and place: keep her or his exact face, skin, hair, clothes, the place and the light, as if this frame came from the same phone video.

output.look: raw, unedited iPhone video frame, not a professional photo

subject: the same woman from the reference, face and shoulders in frame, gently pressing the fingertips of her left hand on her cheekbone where a small glossy drop of serum is spreading; her right hand holds the ALBA bottle at chin height in the lower corner of the frame, label facing the camera; eyes soft and relaxed, looking slightly off-camera toward the mirror, a calm hint of a smile

product.name: ALBA vitamin C face serum (a fictional brand)
product.bottle: a small 30 ml amber-brown glass Boston round dropper bottle with rounded shoulders, about 9 cm tall including the dropper (roughly the length of an adult index finger), smooth glass with subtle real reflections
product.dropper: a glossy black rubber bulb on top of a black ribbed plastic screw collar; when the dropper is out, a clear glass pipette with a narrow tip
product.label: a matte cream paper label (#F4EDE2) wrapped around the middle of the bottle, covering about half of its height, with a thin solid orange band (#F28C28) along its bottom edge; flat, clean print, no gloss
product.label_text: exactly two centered lines and nothing else: 'ALBA' in large bold dark-brown sans-serif capital letters, and below it 'VITAMINA C' in smaller dark-brown sans-serif capital letters; no other words, numbers, icons or symbols
product.serum: a clear, slightly golden, light and fluid liquid
product.rule: the product must look exactly like this in every image: same shape, proportions, colors, materials, label design and label text

environment.location: the same home bathroom in the morning
environment.details: white rectangular tiles, the wooden shelf with rolled beige towels and the small green plant softly out of focus behind her
environment.atmosphere: real, lived-in and slightly imperfect, like a real everyday place, not a staged set or a showroom

camera.device: iPhone main camera, handheld, at a natural human height
camera.framing: vertical close-up from the shoulders up, face in the upper-middle of the frame, a little closer than the talking-head shot
camera.focus: natural phone depth of field, no artificial heavy bokeh
camera.quality: 1080x1920 vertical video frame, slight phone sensor noise, mild compression, true-to-life colors

lighting.key: the same soft, even frontal light from the vanity light bar in front of her, a fresh natural sheen on her skin
lighting.mood: natural and realistic, low contrast, accurate colors, no dramatic lighting

realism_rules: must look like an ordinary frame from a phone video, not AI-generated and not a stock photo
small real-world imperfections: light dust, slight wear, small scratches, uneven surfaces, a few things slightly out of place
nothing too clean, too glossy or perfectly symmetrical
if hands or skin appear: real skin texture with pores and fine lines, correct anatomy, five fingers
negative: any text other than the product label (ALBA / VITAMINA C), captions, subtitles, other logos or brand names, watermarks, UI elements, readable signs or screens
a different bottle, a changed or blank label, misspelled label text, extra products, a second bottle
CGI, 3D render, illustration, overly glossy or plastic surfaces, futuristic or sci-fi look
stock photo look, advertising look, studio lighting, cinematic color grading, HDR, oversaturated colors, heavy bokeh
perfect symmetry, empty sterile spaces, everything brand new
deformed hands, extra fingers, warped objects
a different person, a changed face, a likeness of any real person
heavy makeup, glossy plastic skin, beauty filter
towel on the head, face mask, foam
